text:
hana: quick flag - onboarding sample app is flaking during embed+rerank.

arjun: short summary? error logs?

hana: server returns: 
```
{"error":"bad_request","message":"expected vector len 1536 got 1532 (item idx 4)"}
```

bella: that sounds like JS client trimmed trailing zeros in arrays. seen this before when we stringify arrays with a custom replacer for compact payloads.

hana: here's the exact request body captured from the Chrome network tab (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "vectors": [
    [0.12,0.45,...,0.0 /* missing */],
    [0.98,0.01,...,0.0]
  ],
  "query": "how to onboard embeddings"
}
```

arjun: two separate issues here:
1) field/schema mismatch - server expects items: [{id, vector}] but sample app uses top-level `vectors` array
2) vector length drift - some client path is compressing arrays by trimming trailing zeros

bella: on the SDK side, a helper (batcher.rerank) flattens and dedupes vectors and relies on stable vector length. If length fluctuates, batching index -> id mapping shifts and retries duplicate entries.

hana: repro steps:
1) clone sampleapp
2) yarn
3) yarn start
4) run onboarding flow -> triggers batched rerank -> observe 400s in network tab

bella: quick local fix for sampleapp: middleware that transforms top-level `vectors` into `items` and pads arrays to model dim before sending. example:
```
function normalizePayload(body, dim=1536) {
  const items = (body.vectors || []).map((v,i)=>({id:`item-${i}`, vector: pad(v, dim)}))
  return { items, query: body.query }
}
```

arjun: QA note: add idempotency token per item so when batch helper retries it doesn't create duplicated responses. Also add client-side dim assert to fail fast with a helpful message.

qa-bot: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/732 - "rerank: vector-length trimming and schema mismatch causing 400s". Assigned to @bella.

bella: I'll push an SDK patch to stop the aggressive compacting of arrays when serializing. Also adding sdk option `padVectors: true|false` and `preserveTrailingZeros: true|false` to preserve parity across platforms.

hana: can eng-runtime team also make the error clearer? "vector len mismatch: expected 1536. Hint: check client-side trimming/padding" would save time.

arjun: file a tiny runtime UX issue, but also add a server-side debug header when dims differ so clients get a fast hint (X-Redwood-Vector-Mismatch: expected=1536;got=1532)

devx-bot: PR created - https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/1219 by bella with toggles + unit tests for Node and Browser. CI template updated. :sparkles:

hana: thx. leaving traces here for QA e2e. will re-run onboarding once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
